# Uchit Vyas

> Forward deployed engineer in Melbourne, Australia. Fifteen years building payment, lending and data platforms for regulated banks in Asia and Australia, and now AI agents for regulated companies. Author of five books with Apress and Packt (2013 to 2016). US patent US11334348B2. Employed full-time; not available for consulting.
